# amneziawg-installer

> Open-source Bash installer that turns a clean Ubuntu or Debian VPS into a self-hosted AmneziaWG 3.1 VPN server with one command, with AmneziaWG 2.0 for older clients and routers. The kernel module comes through DKMS or, on some ARM boards, a prebuilt package; there is no Docker and no web panel. MIT licensed.

- It installs upstream AmneziaWG and automates and tunes the server around it. It is not a fork of the protocol and not the official Amnezia VPN app.
- Install (English script):

```bash
wget -O install_amneziawg_en.sh https://github.com/bivlked/amneziawg-installer/releases/latest/download/install_amneziawg_en.sh
chmod +x install_amneziawg_en.sh
sudo bash ./install_amneziawg_en.sh
```

- The Russian-language script is `install_amneziawg.sh` at the same address. Use the `releases/latest/download` address: release assets carry minisign signatures, and the public key is `KEYS.txt` next to them.
- About 20 minutes and two reboots. After each reboot, run the same script again and it continues from the step where it stopped.
- Meant for a clean VPS dedicated to the VPN, not a home router, shared hosting or a server that does other work: the installer hardens and tunes the whole machine (UFW, Fail2Ban, sysctl).
- Systems: for a new server Ubuntu 24.04 or Debian 13; Ubuntu 26.04 is also supported; Debian 12 still works but is kept for existing servers, not new ones; Ubuntu 25.10 is not supported since version 6.0.0. Architectures: x86_64, ARM64, ARMv7. The machine-readable source of truth is `docs/support-matrix.json` (linked below).
- It creates two clients and saves their configs and QR codes (PNG, including a QR of the `vpn://` link for Amnezia VPN) in `/root/awg/` on the server; at the end the script prints where the files are and how to copy them with `scp`. Clients are managed afterwards with `manage_amneziawg.sh` (`add`, `remove`, `list`, `regen`); time-limited access is `add <name> --expires=7d`.
- Recommended clients: WG Tunnel or AmneziaWG on Android, AmneziaWG on iPhone, Mac and Windows (phones scan the QR code, Mac and Windows import the `.conf` file); Amnezia VPN is supported and takes the `vpn://` link.
- Since version 6.0.0 a new install gets the AmneziaWG 3.1 profile (header encryption with `HeaderProtectionKey` and extra padding with `ContentPaddingAddition`). Clients without 3.1 support (routers on stable KeeneticOS, Hiddify, old apps) need a server installed with `--protocol=2.0`. On a kernel older than 6.7 and on ARM the installer picks 2.0 by itself. A running server keeps its generation through updates; switching normally means `--uninstall` and a new install with new client profiles (restoring a backup made on the other generation also changes it). Details are on the AmneziaWG 3.1 and 3.0 page below.
- A Synology NAS (DSM) is not supported by the installer: its kernel is too old to build the module. A manual userspace path is described in the advanced reference, section "AmneziaWG on a Synology NAS (DSM)".
- Everything below exists in English and in Russian.

## Docs

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bivlked/amneziawg-installer/main/README.en.md): overview, quick start, features, supported systems, FAQ
- [Install guide for a VPS](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bivlked/amneziawg-installer/main/INSTALL_VPS.md): step by step from choosing a VPS to the first client, update, uninstall and troubleshooting
- [Advanced reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bivlked/amneziawg-installer/main/ADVANCED.en.md): AmneziaWG 3.1 and 2.0 parameters, client compatibility, presets, mobile carriers, ARM, LXC, deep troubleshooting. Large file
- [Two-server cascade](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bivlked/amneziawg-installer/main/CASCADE.en.md): split exit, Russian traffic through a Russian server and the rest abroad
- [Russian networks through Cloudflare WARP](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bivlked/amneziawg-installer/main/WARP-RU.en.md): route the Russian segment separately on an existing install, without a second server
- [Supported systems, machine-readable](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bivlked/amneziawg-installer/main/docs/support-matrix.json): platforms, vendor support dates and project policy
- [Security policy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bivlked/amneziawg-installer/main/SECURITY.md): supported versions and how to report a vulnerability
- [Changelog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bivlked/amneziawg-installer/main/CHANGELOG.en.md): changes per release

## Guides

- [AmneziaWG VPN installer for Ubuntu and Debian](https://bivlked.github.io/amneziawg-installer/): what the installer does, in one page
- [How it differs from the official Amnezia app](https://bivlked.github.io/amneziawg-installer/compare/): same protocol, different deployment and tuning
- [Add and remove clients](https://bivlked.github.io/amneziawg-installer/manage/): QR codes, vpn:// links, time-limited access, backups, JSON output
- [Two-server cascade VPN](https://bivlked.github.io/amneziawg-installer/cascade/): Russian sites from a Russian IP, the rest through a foreign exit
- [Russian sites that fail through a VPN](https://bivlked.github.io/amneziawg-installer/warp-ru/): a separate route through Cloudflare WARP
- [AmneziaWG 3.1 and 3.0 on your own server](https://bivlked.github.io/amneziawg-installer/awg3/): what a new install gets, how to check it, how to go back to 2.0
